Khilafah MMORPG: Build, Unite, Thrive

About Khilafah

Khilafah MMORPG is a community-built online world where players found cities, forge alliances, and grow a civilization together.

Every road, market, and monument is shaped by the people who play.

Khilafah MMORPG is created and developed by Norman Bhaskara.

Build

Raise districts, workshops, and monuments from the ground up.

Unite

Join guilds, form alliances, and govern with your community.

Thrive

Trade, craft, and explore a world that keeps changing.

Features

Six systems that connect into one living economy and one shared story.

  • Open World ExplorationCross mountains, rivers, and harbor cities by foot, ship, and rail.
  • Kingdom & PoliticsFound a realm, hold council, and shape the laws of your city.
  • Trade & EconomyRun markets, set prices, and move goods along trade routes.
  • PvP & WarsFight in duels and large wars for land and honor.
  • Guild & AllianceForm guilds, sign pacts, and defend shared territory.
  • Crafting & ProfessionsMaster a trade and craft goods the economy needs.

The World

Travel by airship and rail across mountains, rivers, and harbor cities. Glass towers stand beside old stone courtyards.

For Developers

We are building on Unreal Engine 5 and need programmers, 3D artists, designers, and writers. Fill in the form to join the team.

Roadmap

  1. Concept
    World design, art direction, and core systems plan.
  2. Prototype
    Playable city, movement, and building tools.
  3. Crowdfunding
    Campaigns on Kickstarter and Indiegogo.
  4. Closed alpha
    Trade, guilds, and first wars with early testers.
